item.text: I’ll address the browser validation and restart/shutdown findings, and add error handling around worker and request processing. For interrupted attempts, I’ll restore the job to queued and decrement the attempt count, since the interrupted attempt did not complete an actual failure and still needs a chance to run.

The fixes are in place. Interrupted jobs now return to the queue with their attempt count restored; the worker also releases in-flight jobs on shutdown or recoverable errors. I’ve added request-level JSON error handling and forced connection closure on server shutdown. I’m doing the final build and startup check now.

item.text:
Addressed all six findings: browser submissions now reach API validation; interrupted worker attempts are requeued without consuming an attempt; worker errors release jobs for retry; request failures return JSON errors and malformed IDs return 404; shutdown closes server connections; and the worker checks for shutdown between steps.

`npm run build` passes, and the worker starts successfully.
